topic: What happens if you jump from the edge of space?
title: Jump From Space
hook: Could you jump from the edge of space?

beats.label: 39 KM
beats.line: Up here, without a pressure suit, the water in your mouth would boil.

beats.label: 30 KM
beats.line: In twenty twelve, Felix Baumgartner fell faster than the speed of sound.

beats.label: 20 KM
beats.line: With almost no air to steady you, you can spin out of control.

beats.label: 2 KM
beats.line: Lower down, thicker air slows you, and the parachute opens.

beats.label: 0 KM
beats.line: His fall lasted over four minutes before the chute even opened.

end.line: Would you jump from the edge of space?

description: Faster than sound with no plane around you: what a jump from the edge of space is like.

facts.claim: Above about 18-19 km (the Armstrong limit), exposed body fluids like saliva boil at body temperature without a pressure suit.
Felix Baumgartner jumped from about 39 km in 2012 and reached Mach 1.25.
facts.source: Guinness World Records; Red Bull Stratos / NASA

facts.claim: He fought a dangerous flat spin during the fall.
His free fall lasted about 4 minutes 19 seconds before he opened the parachute.
